title: Serogroup B Meningococcal Vaccine (MenB)
overview: Meningococcal B vaccine can help protect against meningococcal disease caused by serogroup B. A different meningococcal vaccine is available that can help protect against serogroups A, C, W, and Y.

sections.Anyone can get meningococcal disease. Ce: Infants younger than one year oldAdolescents and young adults 16 through 23 years oldPeople with certain medical conditions that affect the immune systemMicrobiologists who routinely work with isolates of N. meningitidis, the bacteria that cause meningococcal diseasePeople at risk because of an outbreak in their community
